# Ranked outputs and validation

Final ranked biomarker targets and combination hypotheses; seen vs unseen partitions; RCAN1 sentinel reproducibility (diagnostic, non-forcing).

```{r load-ws-06, include = FALSE, cache = FALSE}
source(here::here("scripts", "stemai_config.R"), local = TRUE)
source(here::here("scripts", "stemai_helpers.R"), local = TRUE)
if (!exists("ranked_mechanistic") && file.exists(STEMAI_FEATURES_RDS)) {
  # ranked_mechanistic created in child 04; reload features if needed
}
if (file.exists(STEMAI_EVIDENCE_RDS)) {
  ev_obj <- readRDS(STEMAI_EVIDENCE_RDS)
  evidence_pkgs <- ev_obj$packages
  evidence_qc_tbl <- ev_obj$qc
}
if (file.exists(STEMAI_FEATURES_RDS)) stemai_features <- readRDS(STEMAI_FEATURES_RDS)
```

```{r ranked-outputs, cache = FALSE}
ranked_targets <- tibble::tibble()
if (exists("ranked_mechanistic") && nrow(ranked_mechanistic) > 0) {
  ranked_targets <- ranked_mechanistic %>%
    dplyr::mutate(rank = dplyr::row_number(), query_scope = STEMAI_QUERY_SCOPE) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      evidence_qc_tbl %>% dplyr::select(.data$target_id, evidence_qc_ok = .data$qc_ok),
      by = "target_id"
    )
}
ranked_combinations <- tibble::tibble(
  rank = 1L,
  combination = "DNMTi (HMA) + selective BCL2i",
  primary_lineages = "SCLC, ExPulm-SCNEC, AML benchmark, DLBCL/high-grade lymphoma, neuroblastoma",
  biomarker_anchor = "RCAN1 methylation/expression + BCL2 context",
  validation_partition = "seen",
  query_scope = STEMAI_QUERY_SCOPE
)
if (exists("evidence_qc_tbl")) {
  failed <- evidence_qc_tbl %>% dplyr::filter(!.data$qc_ok)
  if (nrow(failed) > 0) {
    ranked_targets <- ranked_targets %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        rank_status = dplyr::if_else(.data$target_id %in% failed$target_id, "incomplete_for_ranking", "ok")
      )
  } else {
    ranked_targets <- ranked_targets %>% dplyr::mutate(rank_status = "ok")
  }
}
saveRDS(
  list(
    ranked_targets = ranked_targets,
    ranked_combinations = ranked_combinations,
    query_scope = STEMAI_QUERY_SCOPE
  ),
  STEMAI_RANKED_RDS
)
readr::write_csv(ranked_targets, file.path(stemai_data_dir, "StemAI_ranked_targets.csv"))
readr::write_csv(ranked_combinations, file.path(stemai_data_dir, "StemAI_ranked_combinations.csv"))
```

```{r display-ranked}
knitr::kable(ranked_targets, caption = "Panel 6a. Ranked biomarker targets (hypothesis-generating).")
knitr::kable(ranked_combinations, caption = "Panel 6b. Ranked combination hypotheses.")
```

## Seen vs unseen validation

```{r validation-split-summary}
part_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  Partition = STEMAI_VALIDATION_PARTITIONS,
  Data = c(
    paste(STEMAI_SEEN_SOURCES, collapse = ", "),
    paste(STEMAI_UNSEEN_SOURCES, collapse = ", "),
    "PubMed + slide-deck corroboration"
  )
)
knitr::kable(part_tbl, caption = "Dataset-level validation split (default).")
```

## RCAN1 sentinel reproducibility (scope-locked)

```{r rcan1-sentinel-qc, cache = FALSE}
expr_for_sentinel <- if (exists("stemai_features")) stemai_features else NULL
current_snap <- build_rcan1_sentinel_snapshot(expr_for_sentinel, ranked_targets, evidence_pkgs)
saveRDS(current_snap, STEMAI_RCAN1_LAST_RUN_RDS)
baseline_snap <- if (file.exists(STEMAI_RCAN1_BASELINE_RDS)) readRDS(STEMAI_RCAN1_BASELINE_RDS) else NULL
repro <- compare_rcan1_sentinel(baseline_snap, current_snap)
if (is.null(baseline_snap) || identical(repro$status, "no_baseline")) {
  saveRDS(current_snap, STEMAI_RCAN1_BASELINE_RDS)
  repro$message <- paste(repro$message, "Baseline saved.")
}
saveRDS(repro, STEMAI_REPRO_REPORT_RDS)
knitr::kable(
  tibble::tibble(
    Check = c("Query scope", "Status", "Message"),
    Result = c(STEMAI_QUERY_SCOPE, repro$status, repro$message)
  ),
  caption = "RCAN1 sentinel reproducibility (diagnostic; does not force RCAN1 ranking)."
)
if (length(repro$warnings) > 0) {
  knitr::asis_output(paste0("\n\n**Warnings:** ", paste(repro$warnings, collapse = ", "), "\n"))
}
```
